name: Broken links sweep
description: Scan for broken links, fix internal ones in place, and add 301 redirects for moved URLs instead of editing external targets.

params.name: scope
params.description: post id to scan, or 'all' for every published post.

steps.title: Scan
steps.detail: Call wp_find_broken_links (post_id=<scope> when numeric) and group results: internal vs external, 404 vs timeouts.

steps.title: Fix internal links
steps.detail: For each internal 404 with an obvious replacement (renamed slug), call wp_update_post with the corrected URL, one post at a time, verifying with wp_get_post.

steps.title: Redirect moved URLs
steps.detail: For internal URLs that must keep working (linked from third parties), call wp_set_redirect (301) to the new location, then confirm with wp_list_redirects.

steps.title: Report externals
steps.detail: External broken links are listed with context for the owner: this playbook never edits third-party targets.

guardrails: Never mass-edit posts in one pass: internal link fixes go one by one.
Redirect chains are forbidden: point every redirect at the final live URL.
